assumptions.camera: 3/4 view, slightly top-down; illustrative proportions, not photorealism

collision: Source trunk collision radii are unchanged. New props not present in v0.72 are catalog-only, not automatically collidable.
pagoda: Conjured warding artifact tower, not human-scale architecture. 1..9 physical drawn storeys; fixed base anchor 0.5,878/960.
render_order: depth-sorted objects and actors by ground y
tree_occlusion: Player behind a nearby tree causes that tree to render at 0.38 alpha.
